name: hakim
description: Use ChatGPT as the conversational brain and Hakim as a privacy-minimized, permission-gated Android execution arm.

interface.longDescription: Hakim connects ChatGPT to an authorized Android device through a privacy-minimized execution bridge. The public version can check whether the paired device is connected, request opening a specific app or HTTP/HTTPS link, navigate Home/Back/Recents, and check operation completion. Raw screenshots, notifications, arbitrary taps, free-form text entry, shell, and root are not exposed in the public plugin. State-changing actions remain subject to Hakim and Android approval gates.
capabilities: Check whether the paired Hakim Android device is connected
Open an explicitly selected Android app after device approval
Open an explicit HTTP or HTTPS link after device approval
Navigate Home, Back, or Recents after device approval
Check completion status for a previously requested operation
defaultPrompt: Check whether my authorized Android device is connected through Hakim.
Open Chrome on my authorized Android device with Hakim.
Use Hakim to go back one screen on my authorized Android device.
